name: Painterly Acrylic
description: Acrylic brushes and tools that carry and spend real paint: flats, rounds, a rigger, a fan, hog bristle, dry-brush, scumble, a dagger, palette knife, sponge, rag, sgraffito, and the loaded petal set that makes a flower in one pull.
